facts.text: I am struggling to manage my anxiety.
I want apps or tools to help me track my daily habits and moods.
I am interested in trying out Habitica.
I am worried that Habitica might increase my social media usage.
I want a way to limit my time on Habitica to 30 minutes a day.
I want yoga classes or videos specifically designed for anxiety and stress relief.
I will check out Yoga With Adriene's "Yoga for Anxiety and Stress Relief" video.
I want calming essential oils to use during my yoga practice to enhance relaxation.
I want calming tea blends that I can drink before or after my yoga practice to enhance relaxation.
I am interested in trying out Tulsi Tea (Holy Basil) and Rooibos Tea.
I want a good brand or recipe to make a calming tea blend using Tulsi Tea (Holy Basil) and Rooibos Tea.
